'''Mantellian Troopers''', also known as '''Mantellian Soldiers''' or '''Mantellian Defenders''', were the ground [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Mantellian Army]], the military of the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]].<ref name="TORPLANET" />
